name: Puffin Counter Eilidh

intro.text: Two hundred and twelve, two hundred and thirteen... oh, I've lost count. Your fault. Battle!

win: Two hundred and fourteen. And you.
after: Puffins nest in burrows on clifftop slopes, and they can hold a dozen or more sand eels crosswise in their beaks at once. Nobody knows quite how they do it without dropping the first ones.
